question: The Victoria Memorial built between 1906 and 1921 is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Victoria Memorial** is located in **Kolkata**, West Bengal, India. It is one of the most iconic landmarks and serves as a museum and tourist attraction.
 
• The construction of the memorial began in **1906** and was completed in **1921**. It was built to commemorate **Queen Victoria**, Empress of India.
 
• The architectural style of the memorial is a blend of **British and Mughal elements**. It is made of **white Makrana marble**, giving it a majestic and grand appearance.
 
• The memorial was designed by the architect **William Emerson**, who incorporated influences from **European Renaissance** and Indo-Islamic architecture.
 
• The Victoria Memorial houses a museum that contains **paintings, sculptures, artifacts, and historical documents** related to British India and Queen Victoria.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Location and Accessibility:**

 
 
• The Victoria Memorial is situated in the heart of **Kolkata**, near the **Maidan**, a large urban park.
 
• It is easily accessible by various means of transportation, including **local buses, taxis, and the Kolkata Metro**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Background:**
 
 
• The memorial was commissioned by Lord Curzon, the then **Viceroy of India**, as a tribute to **Queen Victoria**.
 
• It symbolizes the **British imperial legacy** in India and serves as a reminder of the colonial era.
 
 
 
• **Architectural Features:**
 
 
• The central dome is surmounted by a **bronze statue** of Victory, which is approximately **16 feet tall**.
 
• The memorial is surrounded by **lush gardens** designed by Lord Redesdale and David Prain.
 
 
 
• **Significance:**
 
 
• The Victoria Memorial is not just a historical monument but also a **cultural and artistic hub**, hosting exhibitions and events.
 
• It attracts millions of visitors every year, making it one of the most popular tourist destinations in **India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Locations Mentioned:**

 
 
• **Delhi:** Known for historical landmarks like the **Red Fort**, **Qutub Minar**, and **India Gate**, but it does not house the Victoria Memorial.
 
• **Chennai:** Famous for its colonial architecture and cultural landmarks like **Fort St. George**, but not associated with the Victoria Memorial.
 
• **Shimla:** Known for being a former summer capital during British India, it features colonial buildings like **Viceregal Lodge**, but the Victoria Memorial is not located here.
 
 
 
• **Tourism Impact:**
 
 
• The Victoria Memorial is a major contributor to **tourism revenue** in Kolkata and West Bengal.
 
• It is part of India's effort to preserve and promote its **colonial heritage**.
